verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Transform MCP server that links AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, VS Code, etc.) to Transform. Through it, agents can ingest local files and get back partitioned, enriched, chunked and embedded output. Its agent guide also names the MCP server as the preferred integration path. Missing for 10: detailed setup/tool-list documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Transform MCP server enables you to link your AI tools to Transform.
Tools such as the Codex CLI, Claude Code, Visual Studio Code, Cursor, Devin, and JetBrains IDEs are just a few examples.
1. MCP server: Unstructured Transform MCP server
